Celebrate the Christmas season with Fading Voices!
Explore twisting caverns and dense forests, squaring up against filthy creatures, bizarre monsters, and elite soldiers across a vast island at war in turn-based tactical combat, and decide the story with a few key decisions.

Key Features:
- 7-10 hours of playtime
Dive into a captivating experience with a playtime that keeps you engaged from start to finish, in a game that aims to have engaging hours instead of a prolonged void time.

- Unravel the mystery behind the attack on a royal wedding
Embark on a journey to uncover secrets and save a kingdom teetering on the edge of ruin.

- Revamped turn-based combat
Enjoy a dynamic turn-based battle system, enhanced with Quick Time Events, to boost your attack, and dodge enemy attacks, keeping every encounter exciting!

Apply statuses and debuffs that even work on bosses, adding depth to your combat strategies.

- Branching side quests
Complete side quests that can directly influence and alter the main story!

Explore the main narrative with 3 distinct routes and uncover 9 different endings based on your choices.
Get it now!

notes.title: Release date and contents of Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
The time is approaching for the first main update of the game "Sins of Friendship" to release.
The main feature, and what gives the update its name, is clearly the friendship system between characters. This secondary system will allow you to deepen your bonds with party members while also improving battle stats, and add about 1-2 hours of gameplay, offering new bosses and story paths as well. So when will it be released? 13 January 2025.
Hoping to see you there, I'll leave you to the list of updates and the poster for the update.

- Added over 20 new Illustrations/CGs
- Added 5 new languages: Portuguese, Hindi, Polish, Turkish, Japanese
- Added a new QTE type: Circle
- Added a new QTE type: Clock

- Added new Easter Eggs
- Added new portraits

notes.title: Future updates
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Thank you for buying the game, trying out the demo, and for all the wishlists and feedback!
So, what will become of this fun little game? Will it get lost in the depths of Steam?
Nope, while it's true that I'm working on other things and games, I intend to keep this game alive and updated over time, to bring it to an even greater form.
At the moment, I have 3 updates planned.
If all goes well, the updates should be released roughly 3-4 months apart.

The first update, "Sins of Friendship", will include:

- Secret bosses
- Improved menu aesthetics
- New Easter Eggs
- New songs
- New endings
- New side quests
- New type of QTE in battles
- New map
- New enemies
- New languages to play the game in
- A relationship system between characters
- Over 10 new images

The main feature, and what gives the update its name, is clearly the friendship system between characters. This secondary system will allow you to deepen your bonds with party members, improve battle stats, and add about 1-2 hours of gameplay, offering new bosses and story paths as well.
If everything goes according to plans, the update will be released around December-January.

notes.title: The game is live!
notes.notes:
The game is finally published. It has been a long journey, since I started drafting stuff 2 years ago, and started development 9 months ago. The engine I chose was probably not the best (since I was not able to do many of the things I wished), and added to the fact that for the future, I'll develop smaller games, are the reasons why I'll move to Godot. Probably. Me making other games, is not exactly set in stone. Regarding the future of Fading [strike]Echoes[/strike] Voices, I'll release new content updates in the future, which will be free, since I don't really believe in this "Buy the game and spend ten times more in DLCs". I'll release a roadmap in the future. Also, the game doesn't have particular protection against piracy, because it would be pointless, and I have pirated a lot of stuff, so...fair. But at least I tried to prevent it with low price. The past months have been challenging, both in the making of this game, and in private life, so I'm a little burn-out, which is why probably future content will come out in months. So, lastly, I want to thank everyone that has been with me during this journey, in private life, in liking a post, in wishlisting, playing and you, the person who reads this stuff. Thanks for being a part of this journey in my life in any shape or form. Finally, for what I hope is not the last time, I can say "There is an update, let's see what changed:"

notes.title: Update 0.7 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
I had in mind more stuff for this update, but I had to rush it a bit to make it come out with the Steam festival, I'll work for publishing a 0.7.5 or 0.8 as soon as possible, hopefully around next week. The rushed bit will probably be more obvious with the NPCs, since maybe Silika and the Royal Mirage will feel empty. notes.title: Update 0.3 is now live!
notes.notes:
Happy Easter!!! 

Yeah, it passed a bit since actual Easter. Anyway.
This is an update with major focus on tweaking the game, with tweaks to the battle system and more custom assets, which will replace the RPG Maker stuff, but I'm sure you can still find enjoyment from it, with the Blackjack minigame and the new areas and side quests. The Demo will also be updated in the next few days as well, with [u]only the bug fixes, battle tweaks and the custom visuals updates, while the story etc. will stay the same[/u]

The next update, the 0.4, will instead have a major focus on adding story, areas and side quests, while still adding a couple of twists to the gameplay, with new minigames and mechanics. 
It will be a major game's update. And since it will probably take a lot of time to complete it, I will probably update the game piece by piece, with for example a "0.3.5 Update".

Also, as I'm just a single indie dev, I thank you for everything, I didn't expected so many people to actually like the game, I had many doubts about this game. Thank you for everything and I hope you enjoy what comes next.

notes.title: The Next Update
notes.notes:
I'm working on the next update for the game, the 0.3 update, and if everything goes for the right way, both in the development and betatesting departments, it should come out around mid April. I will keep you informed the more the date approaches.

But what there will be in the Update?

- Visual update for Houses and Trees
- New enemies
- New Area
- New Secondary Quest
- New piece of Story
- Fast Travel
- More fluid movement
- Diagonal movement 
- Battle reworked
- Various reworks and bug fixes

As of now, it's completed the "New Area" "Fast Travel" "Fluid/Diagonal movement" "Battle reworked" "Various reworks and bug fixes" parts of the update.
If you want more in-depth talks or see what I'm working on, please refer to the game's social media, which I'm starting to curate more. 
Thanks for reading and happy Easter!
